# Format: one directive per non-empty, non-comment line.
#   MATCH: <prompt>     — regex from config/default-triggers.json for this skill must match
#   NO_MATCH: <prompt>  — regex must NOT match
# Tested deterministically by tests/test-regex-fixtures.sh (zero LLM cost).
# First NO_MATCH line is verbatim-borrowed from the design-debate MATCH fixture.
# Remaining NO_MATCH lines pin the explicit-model-intent boundary (design decision 5):
# routine engineering language must not route here.
#
# Panel is the SEVERAL-models method. Its single-model clause moved to `second-opinion`,
# which carries the same outbound-data controls -- that ORDER matters: moving the clause
# first, before those controls existed, was a security regression. Panel gained a
# two-named-participants clause so an explicit multi-model ask is still claimed here.
